## ⚡ Improved

- **The image comes from Docker Hub.** The Unraid template, `docker-compose.yml` and the `docker run` example pull `junkerderprovinz/strawdroid`, a mirror of the image on GitHub's registry. Unraid can read the update status from Docker Hub, so the Docker tab shows whether StrawDroid is current instead of "not available". A container set up with the old name keeps working; changing its repository field to `junkerderprovinz/strawdroid:latest` moves it over.
